title: Long vowels ai/ee/igh/oa/oo
examples: Teacher, what is the difference between 'ai' and 'a'?
Can you give me more words with the 'ee' sound?
How do I know if I need 'igh' or 'i'?

explain.say: Short vowel sounds are quick, like a in cat. Long vowel sounds are longer, like ai in rain.
The letters ai make one long sound, as in rain. Say rain with me.
The letters ee make one long sound, as in see and tree.
Three letters can make one sound too. The letters igh make the sound in high.
The letters oa make the sound in boat. The letters oo make the sound in moon.

faq.a: A digraph is two letters that make one sound together, like ee in see.
asks: Are two letters always a team?

faq.q: How do I know if a vowel sound is long or short?
faq.a: The short sound is quick, like in 'cat'. The long sound says its name, like in 'cake'.
asks: What is the difference between short and long?
Does the letter name help me know the sound?

faq.q: Do all long vowels use two letters?
faq.a: No, some use two letters like 'ai', and some use three letters like 'igh'.
asks: Must long vowels have two letters?
Can three letters make one sound?

faq.a: Usually, yes. The letters oa make the long o sound, as in boat and coat.
asks: Does 'oa' always mean the same thing?

faq.a: The letters oo make the long sound you hear in moon and food.

facts: A digraph uses two letters to make one sound.
The long vowel sound is the name of the vowel, like 'a' in 'cake'.

quiz.say: Listen to rain. Tap the letters for its middle sound.
quiz.why: Rain has a long middle sound. The letters ai make it.

wrong.0: The letter a alone makes a short sound, so r, a, n says ran.
wrong.2: The letters ee make the long sound in see.

quiz.say: Listen to tree. Tap the letters for its last sound.
quiz.why: Tree ends with a long sound. Here it is spelt ee.

wrong.0: The letter i alone makes the short sound in pig.
wrong.1: The letters ea can make this sound too, but tree is spelt with ee.

quiz.say: Listen to boat. Tap the letters for its middle sound.
quiz.why: Boat has a long middle sound. The letters oa make it.

wrong.1: The letter o alone makes a short sound, so b, o, t says bot.
wrong.2: The letters ow can make this sound too, but boat is spelt with oa.
